comments.author: warmstart
comments.text: The article blames chat tools but I think the real killer was search that never worked. Our intranet had eleven years of policy documents and the search box couldn't find the holiday calendar. People didn't leave for chat because chat was better at knowledge management — it's objectively worse — they left because asking a human in a channel beat fighting the search index.
